description: This file contains unit tests for the HPACK header compression/decompression in HTTP/2, specifically testing round-trip encoding and decoding of header blocks with various input scenarios.

classes.name: HpackRoundTripTest
classes.description: A test class for verifying HPACK header encoding/decoding round-trip with different input split scenarios.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, setting small header table sizes to test eviction.

methods.name: RoundTrip
methods.description: Performs a round-trip test of header encoding and decoding, verifying correctness.

methods.name: SampleExponential
methods.description: Samples a value based on an exponential distribution for test data generation.
